architecture.note: Stub specimen, recorded because five open models name GPT-3's paper as their design reference. Paper sec. 2.1: 'We use the same model and architecture as GPT-2 ... with the exception that we use alternating dense and locally banded sparse attention patterns.' The paper describes 8 sizes; values are for 175B (Table 2.1).

training_data.value: 300B tokens from a weighted mix of filtered Common Crawl, WebText2, Books1, Books2 and English Wikipedia.
